_comment: Operator-supplied few-shot exemplars for assemble_charter.py. These are EXAMPLES — replace them with your own evidence-based exemplars (observed behavior + outcome). Never put submission-technique internals here; the private technique library is deliberately not mined by the public assembler (see SPLIT.md). An entry may carry an optional worker_types list to scope it to a worker type (verify-test | application-executor | cron-worker); absent means all types.

exemplars.text:
Input: posting URL returns HTTP 404/410 or shows removed/expired markers.
Action: classify DEAD, log lead_dead with the evidence, move the lead to the rejected queue — never burn a browser task on a dead page.
Outcome: no wasted browser sessions; legitimate expirations are watched for reposts.
exemplars.title: dead-posting handling

exemplars.text:
Input: a browser application task finished and the tab closed.
Action: claim 'submitted' ONLY with explicit confirmation evidence — the confirmation page text or confirmation message, quoted in the attempt note. Browser-task acceptance, 'looks submitted', or a filled form with no confirmation = blocked, gate noted.
Outcome: the ledger stays truthful; the ingester fail-closes any 'submitted' claim without quoted confirmation.
exemplars.title: submission evidence standard

exemplars.text:
Input: 30-minute pipeline ping; asked for the submission count.
Action: ran the exact count command (exact SUBMITTED rows), got the same number as last ping — reported nothing (stayed silent per the no-change rule) instead of inventing a +1 from a browser task or a row's timestamp.
Outcome: no false alerts; the ledger stayed the single source of truth.
exemplars.title: evidence-grounded status report
